Introduction

An Xin is a Chinese trainee and actor under Chromosome Entertainment and Nouer Entertainment. He is a member of the project boy group ALPHA DRIVE ONE.

He was a contestant on the 2024 survival show MAKE MATE 1 where he made it to the finale. On June 7, 2025, he was revealed to be a contestant on Boys II Planet. During the show's finale, he ranked 2nd, securing his spot in the debut group.
